description:

---------------------------------------------

Join a team that's shaping the future of Advertising & Beyond. At Xapads, you'll work alongside people who challenge convention, embrace innovation, and build AI-powered technologies that help brands connect with audiences across the globe. Whether you're an engineer, marketer, strategist, or storyteller, your ideas have the opportunity to make a real impact. We believe great work is driven by curious minds, collaborative teams, and the freedom to build what's next.

**Please apply safely.** Xapads only communicates recruitment opportunities through our official Careers page and verified **@xapads.com** addresses. We never ask for payments or fees as part of our hiring process. If you receive any suspicious communication or would like to verify a job opportunity, please contact us at career@xapads.com.

  

**Job Information**
-------------------

* Job Type Full time
* Industry Ad Operations
* City Noida
* State/Province Uttar Pradesh
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 201301

**Job Description**
-------------------

### **JOB/COMPANY SUMMARY:**

Born in India, built for the world — Xapads is a 19-year-strong programmatic force with offices in New York, London, Dubai, Singapore, Jakarta, and more. We’re not just present in global markets — we’re making waves. With our in-house platforms like Xerxes (Mobile 1st Performance DSP), Xaprio (Mobile & Web DSP) and Unwire (CTV DSP), we empower 200+ leading brands and agency partners including GroupM, Publicis, OMD, and Dentsu.

  

Our supply operations span across Banner, Native, Video, In-App, CTV, and Web — and we pride ourselves on quality, scale, and speed. Backed by deep integrations with top-tier publishers, OEMs and App Developers.

  

Recognized as a Great Place to Work for four consecutive years and ranked among the Top 100 Companies for Women, we believe in building not just careers, but legacies.

  

Xapads Media, an AdTech leader with a global presence, operates out of India with additional offices in the USA, UK, Russia, China, Singapore, MENA, and Indonesia. We specialize in Connected TV (CTV), video (both web and in-app), and display advertising, leveraging our advanced proprietary technology stacks—Xaprio, Xerxes, and Moments. We are looking for a Senior Operations – Publisher Management to join our team. This role will be instrumental in providing technical and operational support to enhance the performance and yield of our diverse publisher portfolio.

### **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop and maintain strong technical relationships with publishers to ensure a robust and diverse inventory.

* Collaborate closely with the media buying team to understand their needs and ensure alignment with publisher offerings.

* Implement and oversee technical integrations with publishers across various platforms, including CTV, video, web, and in-app.

* Monitor and analyze performance metrics to identify opportunities for optimization and increased yield.

* Lead troubleshooting efforts for any issues related to publisher integration or performance.

* Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in publisher management and ad technology.

* Conduct regular reviews with publishers to discuss performance, challenges, and growth opportunities.

* Implement and manage quality assurance protocols to maintain high standards and compliance across all platforms.

* Develop strategies for fraud detection and prevention, ensuring the integrity and security of our digital advertising operations.

### **QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Information Technology, or a related field.

* Minimum of 6-8 years of experience in operations or publisher management, with specific expertise in CTV, Web, and In-App publishers.

* Strong technical acumen with hands-on experience in ad-serving technologies and digital advertising platforms.

* In-depth knowledge of Programmatic supply onboarding using VAST and ORTB integrations.

* In-depth knowledge and experience with video ad serving tools such as Aniview, SpringServe, Adkernel, and VDO.Ai.

* Proven expertise in using quality assurance and fraud detection tools like IAS, Pixalate, Moat, Double Verify, and other MRC-accredited tools.

* Excellent analytical skills and the ability to derive insights from data.

* Strong communication and presentation skills.

* Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

### **LOCATION:**

Noida, Uttar Pradesh

### **HOW TO APPLY:**

To apply for this position, send an email to our careers mailbox (careers@xapads.com). In the email make sure to include your resume and any additional information you would feel relevant for this role.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**ABOUT XAPADS MEDIA**

Xapads Media is a global AdTech company providing programmatic advertising and digital marketing solutions. We enable brands, app developers, and performance agencies to reach, acquire, and engage target audiences globally across multiple channels. Powered by proprietary technology platforms and direct partnerships across OEM device ecosystems and transparent publisher networks, Xapads delivers scalable, performance-driven advertising solutions.

**ABOUT THE SEGMENT**

The Mobile Performance / UA segment focuses on acquiring high-value app users and driving measurable post-install engagements. Powered by our proprietary Mobile Performance DSP, Xerxes, Xapads connects advertiser growth targets with direct OEM device ecosystems and transparent publisher inventory. Operating across pricing models such as CPI, CPA, CPE, IAA, and IAP, the segment relies on precise attribution, continuous optimization, and fraud prevention to deliver sustainable app scale.

**THE ROLE**

The Executive Supply Operations position is responsible for technical publisher onboarding, integration execution, and daily operational workflows within the Mobile Performance supply ecosystem. Sitting in the Operations department, this individual contributor manages technical setup, publisher integration, campaign feasibility checks, traffic quality analysis, and troubleshooting.

As an addition to the existing Supply Operations team, this role serves as a technical bridge between publisher inventory, internal Media Buying, Campaign Management, Product, and Tech teams. The Executive Supply Operations specialist ensures technical supply connections function reliably, tracking flows operate correctly, and potential fraud risks are identified and resolved.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* End-to-end technical supply operations, including publisher onboarding, technical integration, tracking setup, troubleshooting, and feasibility evaluation.
* Technical publisher integration workflows and placement implementations across OEM device ecosystems, gaming app developers, utility apps, and OTT platforms.
* Operational troubleshooting of integration issues, tracking link discrepancies, postback delivery errors, and publisher performance challenges.
Technical traffic quality validation and fraud prevention analysis for onboarding and active publisher supply.  

  

**WHAT YOU'DO**

* Manage technical integration and onboarding of mobile performance publishers, including OEM ecosystems, gaming app developers, utility apps, and OTT platforms.
* Implement and oversee technical tracking setups, server-to-server (S2S) postbacks, tracking links, and API integrations across publisher endpoints.
* Review and evaluate requests from publishers to assess campaign feasibility across available supply.
* Analyze traffic quality and non-human activity using fraud detection platforms, evaluating click-to-install time (CTIT), postback health, and attribution data to prevent invalid traffic.
* Configure and maintain tracking connections with Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, Kochava, and Singular.
* Support commercial buying evaluation across CPI, CPM, CPC, IAA, and IAP models by aligning publisher inventory capabilities with operational setup requirements.
* Lead technical troubleshooting for integration errors, attribution gaps, postback failures, and publisher delivery bottlenecks.
* Provide performance insights and publisher updates to the Media Buying team to resolve delivery challenges and identify publisher growth opportunities.
Collaborate internally with Media Buying, Campaign Management, Product, and Tech teams to ensure operational efficiency.  

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* 3–4 years of experience in technical supply operations, ad operations, or publisher integration within the AdTech industry.
* Strong technical understanding of the mobile performance ecosystem, conversion tracking flows, postback structures, and key digital AdTech KPIs.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) including AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, Kochava, and Singular.
* Technical experience with ad fraud detection tools such as mFilterIt or TrafficGuard to evaluate traffic quality and prevent non-human activity.
* Direct experience with technical understanding and integration across OEM ecosystems and placements.
Knowledge of performance buying and monetization models, including CPI, CPM, CPC, IAA, and IAP.  

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Exposure to branding, programmatic advertising, or OpenRTB (oRTB) workflows.
* Familiarity with Apple App Store and Google Play Store environments.
Prior experience working with or understanding different publisher DSPs.  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Expansion of publisher revenue footprints driven by seamless technical onboarding and integration execution.
Mastery of industry technology, metrics, and buying/monetization models (CPI, CPA, CPM, IAA, and IAP) applied effectively to daily supply operations.  

  

**Life at Xapads Media:**  
At Xapads Media, we place a strong emphasis on employee growth and continuous development. Individuals are encouraged to build expertise, take ownership of their work, and explore areas that align with their interests over time.

Our culture supports collaboration, knowledge sharing, and open communication. Teams engage in ongoing discussions, exchange ideas, and contribute to broader conversations across the business.

  

We also value moments that bring teams together-recognising achievements, sharing progress, and building a sense of collective momentum.

  

To learn more about our culture and ways of working, visit: https://www.xapads.com/life-at-xapads

  

**Location:**  
**Noida, Uttar Pradesh**

**How to apply**  
**To apply for this position, send an email to our careers mailbox (****careers@xapads.com****). In the email make sure to include your resume and any additional information you would feel relevant for this role.**

DigiLantern is a technology company delivering digital solutions across Application Development, AI, and Digital Transformation. We work with businesses across North America to build scalable digital products and technology solutions.

Position Details

What You'll Do

* Build and ship mobile features using **React Native, Expo and Expo Router**, including screens, navigation, modals and deep links.

* Strong **TypeScript and modern React** fundamentals

* Experience with **REST APIs, caching and optimistic updates**
* Comfortable debugging **Xcode, Android Studio, Gradle, CocoaPods and signing issues**
* Good Git practices and experience working in a monorepo

Good to Have

* Experience with SQL, ORMs or serverless platforms

* Localization and accessibility

description:
**About this Opportunity:**
---------------------------

The Mobile Financial Services (MFS) Solution Consulting Manager is responsible for leading Solution Consulting, Banking \& Financial Services IT Transition Consulting, MFS/Fintech capability establishment and technology transformation initiatives within the MFS Professional Services organization.


The role acts as a strategic bridge between Customers, Sales, Product, Architecture, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, Service Management and Commercial teams.


The individual will develop a deep understanding of the customer's business strategy, business model, operating model, products, processes, organization and existing IT landscape, and translate these insights into scalable, technically feasible, commercially viable and operationally sustainable MFS solutions.


The role will lead customer discovery, solution consulting, RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, solution workshops, POCs, transformation consulting, IT transition and capability\-establishment initiatives.


The role will ensure continuity across the complete lifecycle:


Understand Customer Assess Business \& IT Define Target State Shape Solution Implement Transition Go\-Live Stabilize BAU Continuous Improvement

**What You will do:**
---------------------

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Understand customer business objectives, operating models, technology landscapes, and organizational capabilities.
* Lead customer discovery sessions, assessments, workshops, and strategic consulting engagements.
* Design end\-to\-end MFS and fintech solutions across Mobile Money, Digital Wallets, Digital Payments, Open Banking, Lending, Remittances, KYC/eKYC, Fraud Management, APIs, Analytics, and Core Banking integrations.
* Develop transformation roadmaps, target operating models, business cases, and value propositions.
* Lead Banking \& Financial Services IT transition programs, ensuring operational readiness, governance, risk management, and successful handover to BAU operations.
* Support strategic opportunities through solution development, RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, customer presentations, and executive engagements.
* Drive POCs, pilots, and solution demonstrations.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product, Architecture, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, and Customer Success teams.
* Build consulting capabilities, mentor teams, and develop reusable frameworks, methodologies, and solution assets.

#### **Ideal Candidate Profile**


The ideal candidate is a senior banking, financial services, and fintech technology consulting professional who can seamlessly operate across both customer\-facing Solution Consulting and execution\-oriented IT Transition Consulting.


They should be able to understand and connect: Customer Business \+ Customer IT Landscape \+ People \+ Processes \+ Technology \+ Tools


and translate these insights into practical, scalable, and sustainable MFS and digital financial services solutions.


The successful candidate will be equally comfortable:

* Engaging C\-level banking and fintech executives.
* Assessing enterprise IT and technology landscapes.
* Shaping commercial and transformation propositions.
* Collaborating with architects and engineering teams.
* Defining operating models and governance frameworks.
* Establishing new capabilities and leading complex technology transitions.
**You will bring:**
-------------------


#### **Required Experience**

* 10\-15\+ years of experience in MFS, Fintech, Banking, Payments, Digital Banking, Technology Consulting, Solution Architecture, or Pre\-Sales.
* Strong expertise in solution consulting, customer advisory, enterprise solution design, and technology transformation.
* Proven experience in IT transition, operational readiness, service transformation, and technology modernization.
* Experience working with banks, financial institutions, fintechs, mobile network operators (MNOs), payment service providers, or technology partners.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience managing complex RFP/RFI/RFQ engagements and strategic customer opportunities.

#### **Preferred Experience**

* Multi\-country fintech or MFS programs.
* Open Banking/Open Finance initiatives.
* Cloud transformation and banking modernization programs.
* Greenfield fintech or digital banking capability establishment.
* Experience building consulting or professional services organizations.

#### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Finance, or a related field.
* MBA/Master's degree and relevant industry certifications preferred.

 **All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.**
